== Scripted Input ==
Archivo: `src/debug/ScriptedInput.h`
JSON de scripts: `assets/test_scripts/<name>.json`

Ejemplo (combat_basic.json ya creado):
```json
[
  { "t": 0.5, "action": "MOVE_RIGHT", "duration": 2.0 },
  { "t": 2.5, "action": "ATTACK_LIGHT" },
  { "t": 5.5, "action": "ABILITY_Q" },
  { "t": 9.5, "action": "PARRY" }
]
```

Actions disponibles: MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT (con `duration`), ATTACK_LIGHT, ATTACK_HEAVY, DASH, PARRY, ABILITY_Q, ABILITY_E, INTERACT, OPEN_INVENTORY/INFO/ABILITIES.

Tap actions disparan 1 frame. MOVE_* requieren `duration`.

Ejecutar:
```
build\INFERNUS.exe --headless --script combat_basic --duration 10
```
o sin --headless si quieres ver el bot jugando con ventana.

Telemetry.jsonl ya captura:

- events: room_entered, hit_dealt {dmg,type,crit,victim}
